<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 183.0451, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.0378 Da. The formula C₁₂H₆O₂ matches this mass (calculated monoisotopic mass = 182.0368 Da) within typical experimental error and provides a reasonable degree of unsaturation (DBE = 10). No other common heteroatoms are indicated by the isotopic pattern. Therefore the molecular formula is C12H6O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H6O2</final_answer>
